cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says births enrol people in the ID system and deaths retire their numbers. The 2026 card is to carry birth certificate details; registration from birth is still asked for, not done.
cells.note: NIDA says the Jamii number is deactivated at death over an operational CRVS-ID API (2026), and the card unveiled in November 2026 is to carry birth certificate details (TZA-008). Registration from birth is still a plan, so births do not yet enrol people and 3 holds.
